$comment: Explicit allowlist of adapted Agency Agents roles. Wrappers in claude/ and codex/ are generated from this file by scripts/build_agent_roster.py; edit profile.md and this file, then regenerate.

roles.description: Turn a clear ask into a PM brief and executable work packages with acceptance criteria. Use only when explicitly asked for the product-manager role; scoping conversations belong to your own intake process. Advisory, never edits code or ships.
Walk a flow and report friction with observed/reported/simulated/assumed evidence tags and next research. Use only when explicitly asked for the ux-researcher role. Advisory, read-only.

Produce implementable UI direction (hierarchy, tokens, components, all states) inside the existing brand system. Use only when explicitly asked for the ui-designer role. Never edits production code or ships.

Review the implemented UI in the running preview for specificity and finish; report blocks/should-fix/notes with screenshots and verification conditions. Use only when explicitly asked for the ui-finish-gate-reviewer role. Read-only, not the merge gate.

Answer a bounded architecture question with options, tradeoffs, a recommendation and an ADR-style decision record. Use only when explicitly asked for the software-architect role. Advisory, never implements.

Map a complete workflow tree: happy path, branches, failure modes, recovery, handoff contracts, observable states. Use only when explicitly asked for the workflow-architect role. Advisory, never implements.

Explain an unfamiliar repo or module by tracing real code paths and citing file:line; report docs-vs-code discrepancies. Use only when explicitly asked for the codebase-onboarding-engineer role. Read-only.

Mid-work mentoring review of a diff: correctness, security, maintainability, performance, tests, each finding with file:line and failure scenario. Use only when explicitly asked for the code-reviewer role. Read-only; a dedicated ship-gate reviewer, if your project has one, remains the merge gate.

Security audit of agent-written code: secrets, RLS, injection sinks, auth placement, env exposure; CWE-mapped findings with fixes. Use only when explicitly asked for the ai-code-security-auditor role. Static/local checks only, read-only.

Independently run the feature in the local preview or CLI and report each claim as verified/not verified/broken with evidence. Use only when explicitly asked for the reality-checker role. Read-only on code, never fixes or ships.
